points.title: Increase evidence for solved stage against baseline
points.detail: Your ladder shows 4/50 at solved versus baseline 12/100. To move this, film 20 more clips that reach the solved state, focusing on the final hand-off and verification, and export the extended sequence. This directly targets the solved rung and its bottleneck, and will be evaluated against the baseline in the next pass.

points.title: Re-run shuffled control and align rung measurements
points.detail: The run lacked a shuffled control and some rungs were unmeasured. Re-run with the same clips and actions, ensuring a shuffled control is included, and collect measured data for all rungs including lifted, moved, moved all 2, and lifted all 2. This will let the ladder counts reflect true correspondences.

points.title: Provide full task instructions and license provenance
points.detail: No task list and license information are present. Add a clear task list describing each clip and attach license provenance for all components. This clarifies what is being measured and legal usage for the footage and pipeline.

robot.no_control_arm.detail: Explanation: This finding means the data cannot be attributed to clip correspondence. Action: Run the shuffled control with the same clips, actions, and steps, and export the new results.

robot.rungs_unmeasured.say: The baseline arm had unmeasured rungs.
robot.rungs_unmeasured.detail: Explanation: Unmeasured rungs on the baseline produce a false loss signal. Action: Re-run the baseline with equivalent instrumentation or compare only on rungs that are measured in both arms.

robot.not_separated_on_success.say: Success rate did not separate from baseline.
robot.not_separated_on_success.detail: Explanation: Measures like success at this rung do not separate, limiting discriminative power. Action: Inspect lower rungs in the same rolls and ensure measurements are consistent across clips.

robot.bottleneck.detail: Explanation: The bottleneck is the jump from 'lifted all 2' to 'solved'. Action: Add more clips clearly showing the 'solved' outcome, and ensure footage demonstrates the transition past the bottleneck.

signal.present.say: Model fit predicts actions better on held-out clips.
signal.present.detail: Explanation: The signal shows a real relation; no action required unless deep analysis is needed. This enables relying on the signal metric for future improvements.

capture.one_instruction.detail: Explanation: Each clip should be described with its own action. Action: Describe each clip individually and export updated annotations for all 58 clips.

coverage.no_task_list.detail: Explanation: Without a task list, it's unclear what is being measured. Action: Provide the evaluation task list and attach it to the dataset.

extraction.healthy.say: All extraction stages are above their floors.
extraction.healthy.detail: Explanation: Footage limits the dataset, not the pipeline. No action needed.

provenance.nothing_declared.detail: Explanation: Data usage is unknown. Action: Attach licence information for all components and data sources.

stillness.none.say: Every action moves in all 58 clips.
stillness.none.detail: Explanation: No action required; this confirms motion coverage across clips.

points.title: Capture more footage of the solved stage
points.detail: The ladder shows 0/50 at the 'solved' rung against a 12/100 baseline, indicating a bottleneck at or after 'lifted all 2'. To raise the score, film at least 20 additional clips that clearly depict the 'solved' stage, and export these new clips with the same camera angles and timing as the existing set.

points.title: Run the shuffled control for proper attribution
points.detail: The robot test flags a missing shuffled control, so differences cannot be tied to your footage. Re-run with the same clips, actions, and steps, but assign each clip’s actions to a different clip, ensuring a true shuffled control comparison and a new verdict you can use to judge improvements.

points.title: Provide provenance and task guidance
points.detail: Your data shows no licence and no task list, which blocks interpretability. Supply licence for each component and include the exact evaluation task list used during checking. No action needed if these are already present; otherwise add the licences and the documented task list to enable proper assessment.

robot.no_control_arm.say: no shuffled control was run, so any difference here cannot be attributed to the footage
robot.no_control_arm.detail: Re-run the test with a shuffled control using the same clips and actions, and ensure the same number of gradient steps. This will enable a valid comparison against the baseline and allow attribution of performance changes to the footage.

robot.rungs_unmeasured.say: the 'baseline' arm reported no lifted, moved events
robot.rungs_unmeasured.detail: Instrument the baseline arm for all rungs or compare only on rungs both arms measure. Ensure comparable measurements so the rung data can be meaningfully scored.

robot.bottleneck.say: 62% of scenes are lost between 'lifted all 2' and 'solved'
robot.bottleneck.detail: Increase footage of the 'solved' part, capturing clearly multiple instances, to show it functioning beyond the current 31/50 clips. Include at least 20 new clips of the 'solved' stage and export them.

signal.present.say: a fit on your clips predicts held-out actions 37% better
signal.present.detail: No change needed unless you want to extend the dataset; this finding is positive and enables stronger validation of the control signal.

capture.one_instruction.detail: Describe each clip by what was actually done in it, rather than reusing one sentence for the whole upload. Add a sentence per clip to improve instruction clarity for the model.

coverage.no_task_list.say: No evaluation task list was supplied
coverage.no_task_list.detail: Pass the instructions the benchmark evaluates by including a task list. If already present, ensure it is attached and clearly linked to the clips.

extraction.healthy.say: Every measured extraction stage for your data is above its floor
extraction.healthy.detail: No action required; this is good news and indicates the pipeline is within expected limits.

provenance.nothing_declared.say: Your data carries no licence information at all
provenance.nothing_declared.detail: Add licence information for each component or data segment used. If licences exist elsewhere, reference them here to clarify allowed uses.

stillness.none.say: Every part of the action moves in all 58 clips
stillness.none.detail: No action needed; this is a positive finding indicating comprehensive motion across clips.
